question: Show all students with CGPA greater than 8
sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, cgpa FROM students WHERE cgpa > 8.0 ORDER BY cgpa DESC;

question: Show instructor names and their department budget
sql: SELECT i.name, d.department_name, d.budget FROM instructors i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.department_id;

question: Show students who got grade A or A+ in any course
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.grade IN ('A', 'A+');

question: Show all corporate departments with their locations
sql: SELECT dept_id, dept_name, location FROM corp_departments;

question: List employees hired after 2020 with their department name
sql: SELECT e.emp_name, e.job_title, cd.dept_name, e.hire_date FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id WHERE e.hire_date > '2020-01-01' ORDER BY e.hire_date ASC;

question: Total salary expenditure per department
sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, SUM(e.salary) AS total_expenditure FROM corp_departments cd JOIN employees e ON cd.dept_id = e.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_name ORDER BY total_expenditure DESC;

question: Show the highest paid employee in each department
sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, e.emp_name, e.salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id);

question: What is the total revenue for each product
sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: List the names of instructors who earn more than 90000
sql: SELECT name, salary FROM instructors WHERE salary > 90000 ORDER BY salary DESC;

question: How many students enrolled in each year
sql: SELECT enrollment_year, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students GROUP BY enrollment_year ORDER BY enrollment_year;

question: Which course has the most credits
sql: SELECT course_code, course_title, credits FROM courses ORDER BY credits DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show the number of courses taught by each instructor
sql: SELECT i.name, COUNT(c.course_id) AS course_count FROM instructors i LEFT JOIN courses c ON i.instructor_id = c.instructor_id GROUP BY i.instructor_id, i.name ORDER BY course_count DESC;

question: List students who are not enrolled in any course
sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name FROM students s LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.enrollment_id IS NULL;

question: Find the average grade point of students in each semester
sql: SELECT semester, ROUND(AVG(grade_point), 2) AS avg_grade_point FROM enrollments GROUP BY semester ORDER BY semester;

question: Show the full name and email of students whose last name starts with S
sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM students WHERE last_name LIKE 'S%' ORDER BY last_name;

question: Which departments have more than 15 students
sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS student_count FROM departments d JOIN students s ON d.department_id = s.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name HAVING COUNT(s.student_id) > 15;

question: List the courses that students took in Spring 2024 along with the student names
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, c.course_title FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.semester = 'Spring 2024';

question: Which student has the highest CGPA in each department
sql: SELECT d.department_name, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.cgpa FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE s.cgpa = (SELECT MAX(s2.cgpa) FROM students s2 WHERE s2.department_id = s.department_id);

question: Count how many students received each grade
sql: SELECT grade, COUNT(*) AS total FROM enrollments GROUP BY grade ORDER BY total DESC;

question: Show instructors who do not teach any course
sql: SELECT i.name, i.email FROM instructors i WHERE i.instructor_id NOT IN (SELECT instructor_id FROM courses WHERE instructor_id IS NOT NULL);

question: What is the average salary of instructors in each department
sql: SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(i.salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM instructors i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;

question: List students with a CGPA above the overall average
sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, cgpa FROM students WHERE cgpa > (SELECT AVG(cgpa) FROM students) ORDER BY cgpa DESC;

question: Show the department with the largest budget
sql: SELECT department_name, building, budget FROM departments ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which students took more than 3 courses
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(e.course_id) AS courses_taken FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(e.course_id) > 3;

question: Which customers are located in Germany or France
sql: SELECT customer_name, city, country FROM customers WHERE country IN ('Germany', 'France');

question: List products in the Audio category sorted by price
sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Audio' ORDER BY unit_price DESC;

question: How many orders are in each status
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;

question: Show customers who have never placed an order
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, c.country FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

question: What is the most expensive product in each category
sql: SELECT category, product_name, unit_price FROM products p WHERE unit_price = (SELECT MAX(unit_price) FROM products WHERE category = p.category);

question: List the product names and quantities for each order item
sql: SELECT oi.order_id, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.price_per_unit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY oi.order_id;

question: What is the total value of stock for each category
sql: SELECT category, SUM(unit_price * stock_quantity) AS stock_value FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY stock_value DESC;

question: Show orders with a total amount above 1000 that are still processing
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 1000 AND status = 'Processing';

question: Find the number of customers in each city
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

question: Which customers spent more than 5000 in total
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 5000 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Show the latest order placed by each customer
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;

question: List shipped orders from March 2024
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'Shipped' AND order_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31';

question: How many units of each product have been sold
sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC;

question: Which products have never been ordered
sql: SELECT product_name, category FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items);

question: What is the cheapest and most expensive product price
sql: SELECT MIN(unit_price) AS cheapest, MAX(unit_price) AS most_expensive FROM products;

question: Who is the most recently hired employee
sql: SELECT emp_name, job_title, hire_date FROM employees ORDER BY hire_date DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List employees whose job title contains Engineer
sql: SELECT emp_name, job_title FROM employees WHERE job_title LIKE '%Engineer%';

question: Show the average salary of all employees
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_salary FROM employees;

question: Which employees work in the Sales & Marketing department
sql: SELECT e.emp_name, e.job_title FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id WHERE cd.dept_name = 'Sales & Marketing';

question: List the top 3 highest paid employees with their department
sql: SELECT e.emp_name, cd.dept_name, e.salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many employees were hired in each year
sql: SELECT SUBSTR(hire_date, 1, 4) AS hire_year, COUNT(*) AS employees_hired FROM employees GROUP BY SUBSTR(hire_date, 1, 4) ORDER BY hire_year;

question: Which department has the highest average salary
sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_id, cd.dept_name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show employees earning less than the company average salary
sql: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary < (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees) ORDER BY salary;

question: List corporate departments that have no employees
sql: SELECT dept_name, location FROM corp_departments WHERE dept_id NOT IN (SELECT dept_id FROM employees WHERE dept_id IS NOT NULL);

question: Show the salary range minimum and maximum for each corporate department
sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, MIN(e.salary) AS min_salary, MAX(e.salary) AS max_salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_id, cd.dept_name;

question: How many rows are in the students table
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_students FROM students;

question: Show the building of the department where Computer Science is located
sql: SELECT department_name, building FROM departments WHERE department_name = 'Computer Science';

question: Which instructor teaches the course with code CS101
sql: SELECT i.name, c.course_code, c.course_title FROM courses c JOIN instructors i ON c.instructor_id = i.instructor_id WHERE c.course_code = 'CS101';
